      "name": "fleet_now",
      "displayName": "Fleet Now",
      "queryLines": [
        "SELECT COUNT_IF(ts_gps >= current_timestamp()-INTERVAL 5 MINUTES) AS active_buses,\n",
        " coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN ts_gps >= current_timestamp()-INTERVAL 5 MINUTES THEN onboard END),0) AS total_onboard,\n",
        " COUNT_IF(ts_gps >= current_timestamp()-INTERVAL 5 MINUTES AND load_factor>=0.75) AS crowded_buses,\n",
        " timestampdiff(SECOND,MAX(ts_gps),current_timestamp()) AS freshest_gps_lag_s,\n",
        " MAX(ts_gps) AS max_ts_gps_utc\n",
        "FROM transit.silver.vehicle_latest WHERE data_origin='observed'"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "route_now",
      "displayName": "Route Now",
      "queryLines": [
        "SELECT route_short_name,COUNT(*) AS active_buses,SUM(onboard) AS onboard,\n",
        " SUM(capacity) AS capacity,try_divide(SUM(onboard),SUM(capacity)) AS fleet_load_factor,\n",
        " MAX(load_factor) AS max_bus_load_factor,MAX(ts_gps) AS max_ts_gps_utc\n",
        "FROM transit.silver.vehicle_latest\n",
        "WHERE data_origin='observed' AND ts_gps>=current_timestamp()-INTERVAL 5 MINUTES\n",
        "GROUP BY route_short_name ORDER BY fleet_load_factor DESC"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "headway_hour",
      "displayName": "Headway Hour",
      "queryLines": [
        "SELECT route_short_name,direction_id,date_trunc('hour',arrive_ts) AS hour_utc,\n",
        " COUNT(*) AS n_headways,COUNT(headway_ratio) AS n_valid_ratios,\n",
        " try_divide(stddev_samp(obs_headway_s),AVG(obs_headway_s)) AS headway_cv,\n",
        " AVG(CAST(is_bunched AS DOUBLE)) AS bunching_rate,\n",
        " AVG(CAST(is_gap AS DOUBLE)) AS gap_rate,SUM(CAST(is_gap AS INT)) AS gaps\n",
        "FROM transit.silver.headways WHERE data_origin='observed' AND arrive_ts>=current_timestamp()-INTERVAL 7 DAYS\n",
        "GROUP BY route_short_name,direction_id,date_trunc('hour',arrive_ts) ORDER BY hour_utc DESC,route_short_name"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "stop_visits",
      "displayName": "Stop Visits",
      "queryLines": [
        "SELECT v.route_short_name,v.stop_id,s.stop_name,COUNT(*) AS n_visits,\n",
        " AVG(v.dwell_s) AS avg_dwell_s,SUM(v.net_board_proxy) AS net_board_proxy\n",
        "FROM transit.silver.stop_visits v LEFT JOIN\n",
        " (SELECT stop_id,MAX(stop_name) AS stop_name FROM transit.silver.gtfs_stops GROUP BY stop_id) s USING(stop_id)\n",
        "WHERE v.data_origin='observed' AND v.arrive_ts>=current_timestamp()-INTERVAL 7 DAYS\n",
        "GROUP BY v.route_short_name,v.stop_id,s.stop_name ORDER BY n_visits DESC"
      ]
    },

        " SELECT *, row_number() OVER (\n",

        "   ORDER BY scoring_ts DESC) AS rn\n",

        "), latest AS (SELECT * FROM verified WHERE rn=1)\n",
        "SELECT horizon_min,route_short_name,actual_data_origin,model_name,model_version,\n",
        " COUNT(*) AS n,AVG(ABS(pred_p50-actual_p90_load)) AS mae_load_factor,\n",
        " AVG(CAST(actual_in_p10_p90 AS DOUBLE)) AS interval_coverage\n",
        "FROM latest GROUP BY horizon_min,route_short_name,actual_data_origin,model_name,model_version\n",

      ]
